subject: RE: Integration / Sandbox Access Inquiry
body:
Hi CASEpeer team,

I'm following up on case #01478487 and my September 15 and 22 emails. We still don't have an account to evaluate an integration, and I haven't received a human response to the access request.

Could you please connect me with someone on your partnerships or integrations team? We'd appreciate a clear answer on whether a developer, sandbox, or evaluation account is available. If testing must happen through a client firm's account, please confirm the required setup and permissions.

Thanks for your time and help getting this to the right person.

Best,
Pranav Modi
Founder, Possible Minds  ---- On Mon, 20 Jul 2026 23:52:19 +0530 CASEpeer Support <support@casepeer.com> wrote ----

       
   
    Hi Pranav,
  
 Thank you for reaching out with your questions about integrating with CasePeer.
  
 CasePeer does not currently offer an open API. However, we do have an integration with Zapier and a Nightly Data Sync available with CasePeer Advanced. If you have suggestions for desired endpoints, you can share them with our team.
  
 Here is some additional information that may be helpful:
  
 Activate the Zapier Integration
 1. Navigate to the gear icon in the top right corner of your account and select Account Settings.
 2. Scroll down to the Integrations section and find the Zapier integration.
 3. Click Activate.
 4. A pop-up window will appear.
 5. Copy the API Key listed in the box and click Save.
 6. Note: If you fail to click Save before exiting the pop-up window, repeat the previous step to copy and save the new API Key.
 7. Navigate to Zapier and log in.
 8. Click My Apps in the left-hand side toolbar.
 9. Click Add Connection.
 10. A pop-up window will appear.
 11. Search and select CasePeer.
 12. A new window will open.
 13. Paste the API Key from CasePeer into the box and click Yes, Continue.
 14. Zapier will reload and display the successful connection.
  
 Activate Data Sync Integration Functionality for Reporting
 This feature is available on CasePeer Advanced. Our data sync integration enables a firm to report on its data at a higher level. Firms are provided an API key to connect to their favorite compatible business intelligence tools.
 1. Navigate to the gear icon in the top right corner of your account and select Account Settings.
 2. Scroll down to the Additional Features section and locate Data Sync.
 3. Copy the API key and Select Save.
 4. Enter the API key into your preferred business intelligence tools application.
  
 If you still need help, respond to this email and an agent will get back to you! For your records, your case number is 01478487.
  
 Best regards, 
 Margo AI, Your 8am AI Assistant

Hi CASEpeer team,

Im Pranav, founder of Possible Minds. We build intake automation and AI workflow tools for legal teams, especially around lead intake, follow-up, and operational handoffs.

Im reaching out to ask about CASEpeer integration options. Were evaluating how our intake automation product could work with CASEpeer, and Id love to understand the best path for testing an integration.

I saw that CASEpeer may not have a fully open API, but that there may be partner integration options, Zapier, and data sync paths. A few questions:
- Is there sandbox or trial access available for integration evaluation?
- Is there a partner or developer route for teams building around CASEpeer?
- Is there a Partner Integration API path we should explore?
- What API, Zapier, or data-sync documentation should we review first?
- Is support@casepeer.com the right place for this, or should I speak with someone on partnerships/integrations?

Happy to provide more context on what were building.

Best,
Pranav Modi
Founder, Possible Minds
